baseline.recording_window_definition: Recorder process start to stop; includes reset/setup/teardown/waits; not the precise manipulation task clock.

reconstructed_visual_window.definition: After-zero-confirmed snapshot earliest host receipt through final retained-pen snapshot latest host receipt; explicitly reconstructed visual window, not an originally logged task timer.
reconstructed_visual_window.comparison_rule: Can compare with first task RGB receipt to final success RGB receipt in optimized trial, keeping endpoint definitions and supervision difference explicit.

post_home_command_window.definition: First post-home ROS intent to final retreat stable receipt; excludes pre-first-command reasoning and post-last-command visual verification.
post_home_command_window.comparison_rule: Derive same window and sum from only ROS command sequences used by optimized task steps; exclude commissioning and reset commands.

baseline.baseline_success_scope: One supervised success with onsite side-alignment guidance; autonomous success probability unknown.
optimized_metrics_sources: current frozen-driver command log for exact intent/stable pairing
comparison_limits: Cannot compute model call reduction percentage without baseline model call count.
Cannot compute mean model-latency reduction without baseline request times.
One optimized trial estimates neither a robust success probability nor a change in success rate.
Optimized model_total_s is backend wall latency, not isolated provider reasoning time.

model_pause_explanation: The complete right tool and its attachments are outside the visible frame, leaving approach clearance unresolved.
kpi_conclusion: No completed optimized task, so <30min completion and speedup/success-rate targets have not been demonstrated. Baseline model timing/count missing.
